blockdurability.configuration.title: Block Durability Configuration
blockdurability.configuration.general.to: Basic system toggle, bullet damage settings, and healing timeout rules
Define which blocks can receive damage from guns and explosions
blockdurability.configuration.hp_calcula: Configure block HP formulas based on hardness and per-block overrides
Configure residual damage for TaCZ explosives, vanilla explosions, and physics contraptions
blockdurability.configuration.effects.to: Configure hit sounds, crack/break particles, and item drops
blockdurability.configuration.enabled.to: Master switch to enable or disable the block durability system
blockdurability.configuration.damagePerH: Fixed damage dealt per bullet hit when useBulletDamage is false
blockdurability.configuration.useBulletD: If true, deals damage based on actual TaCZ bullet power
blockdurability.configuration.bulletDama: Global multiplier applied when useBulletDamage is true
blockdurability.configuration.healTimeou: Seconds of inactivity before damaged blocks heal and clear crack overlays (0 to disable)
blockdurability.configuration.blockWhite: List of breakable blocks: supports 'tag:namespace:path', 'modid:block', and wildcards 'modid:*'. Blocks not in this list are immune to durability damage
blockdurability.configuration.hardnessMu: Block HP = max(minBlockHP, hardness * multiplier). Hardness correlates with explosion resistance
blockdurability.configuration.minBlockHP: Minimum HP allowed for any whitelisted block (prevents instant-break zero-HP blocks)
blockdurability.configuration.blockHPOve: Per-block HP overrides ('modid:block=hp', wildcards supported). Takes priority over the hardness formula
blockdurability.configuration.damageMult: Multiplier for durability damage caused by explosions
Maximum radius scanned for explosion damage (performance safety clamp, default 16)
blockdurability.configuration.handleVani: Whether to apply residual falloff durability damage to blocks surviving TNT, creepers, etc.
blockdurability.configuration.spawnBreak: Spawn block particles at hit locations when damaged or broken
blockdurability.configuration.playBreakS: Play hit sounds when damaged, and break sounds when destroyed
Whether destroyed blocks drop standard item drops (false by default for building balance)
gamerule.blockDurabilityHealSeconds.desc: Seconds before damaged blocks automatically heal and clear crack overlays (0 to disable)
